title: Circuit Ohm's Law Lab
introduction: Explore how the current and resistance in a simple circuit set the voltage that lights the lamp.

guided_steps.instruction: Change the current and watch how the voltage across the resistor responds.
Change the resistance and watch the lamp brighten or dim.
Explain how current and resistance combine to set the voltage.

reflection_questions.question: What happens to the voltage as resistance increases while the current stays constant?
